title: Tall white in an Orcas pub asks what it's like to live on Earth
plain: In a pub on Orcas Island, in Washington State, a very tall, pale stranger of the kind some people call a "Tall White", meaning a type of alien said to look almost human, is said to have asked a local what it is like to live here, and when the local misunderstood, he answered, "No, on Earth." Brent Friedman, a guest on an episode about Hollywood and the CIA, tells it as something an unnamed friend on the island told him. If true, it would mean such beings walk among people unnoticed.
